notes: Random view kinds, selected flight and member, network flag and taxi index against four random unit records (names, flight 0..3 or 0xff, refuel index, AI and dogfight modes, taxi slot) with random flight, waypoint, base, apron and refuel records. The unit lookup 0x7489c returns a random sequence of null or unit records; 0x3d7b0 is a logging stub. sprintf logs its format and the arguments the format consumes and copies the format as the text; both draw routines log their position and text; strcat, strcpy and upper-case are asm stubs (the originals use es); 0x8f3c0 runs the original code.
